page.overview:
What is Double-Fork Ridge?

On Double-Fork Ridge, Tang Sanzang met the first tribulation on his long journey when he was captured by General Yin and his two attendants were eaten in front of him. He was saved by the Great White Golden Star, and found by Lou Boqin, the guardian of the mountain. Lou Boqin took him to the mountain village where his family lives and cared for him for the night.
